scope: Probe-only manual correction preserving a logical subject across fresh tracking segments.
status: Implemented; static source review only; Xcode build and device validation pending.
review: Reviewed cache reset sites, subject assignment, correction suffix invalidation, exact timestamp replay, cache ownership/hash reads and error paths.
Reviewed report optional-struct mutations to avoid simultaneous read/write access.
Inspected unchanged OwnedTemporalSession.reset and next initialization behavior.
Checked historical Mac report readers: v1-only guards remain unchanged; v2 multi-segment reports are not accepted.

expectedDeviceCases.expected: Subject and cache preserved; model memory reset; exact cached mask shown only on matching PTS.

expectedDeviceCases.case: Correct at first incorrect frame; reselect later
expectedDeviceCases.expected: Prefix retained; suffix removed; fresh segment under same UUID; gap replays without overlay and labelled untracked.

expectedDeviceCases.case: Correct and reselect on same frame
expectedDeviceCases.expected: Boundary mask replaced; no duplicate timestamps.

expectedDeviceCases.case: Correct earlier than an existing correction
expectedDeviceCases.expected: All masks from new boundary onward removed, including old replacement segment.
Prediction count, inference state and subject UUID unchanged by replay; working frame restored.
Existing timeline can replay as untracked until replacement masks exist.

expectedDeviceCases.case: Failed correction initialization or disk truncation
expectedDeviceCases.expected: Pending correction and retained prefix remain; invalidated suffix cannot replay; seek and retry or explicitly start new subject.
Confirmation required; old mask cache cleared; subsequent initialization assigns new UUID.

expectedDeviceCases.case: Leave view or import new video
expectedDeviceCases.expected: Temporary cache and old subject released.

limitations: Identity is asserted by user reselection, not automatically proven.
No automatic hand/loss detector or identity confidence threshold.
No undo of invalidation; no persistent project cache or export integration.
Cache still limited to 2048 masks / 256 MiB payload.
Prefix metadata digest is not a runtime disk preservation test.
No model, precision, compute-unit, exporter or accuracy-gate changes.
